GOOGLESUPER_MUTATE_CAMPAIGNS.description: Create, update, or remove Google Ads campaigns in batch. Supports multiple operations (create, update, remove) in a single request. Use when managing campaign lifecycle, applying bulk changes, or automating campaign management workflows. This action is irreversible for remove operations — deleted campaigns cannot be recovered. Plan accordingly and consider using validate_only=true to test changes before applying them.

name.description: Name of the campaign. Must be unique within the customer account. Required for create.

manual_cpc.description: Manual CPC bidding strategy. Provide an empty object {} to use manual CPC without a bidding strategy.

end_date_time.description: End date and time of the campaign in the customer's timezone, formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'. Use '23:59:59' for daily granularity.

resource_name.description: Resource name of the campaign for update operations. Format: customers/{customer_id}/campaigns/{campaign_id}. For account-owned resources, use the same customer ID as the tool call's customer_id; in MCC workflows, this is the child/sub-account ID.

campaign_budget.description: Resource name of an existing campaign budget to associate with the campaign, e.g. 'customers/{customer_id}/campaignBudgets/{budget_id}'. For account-owned resources, use the same customer ID as the tool call's customer_id; in MCC workflows, this is the child/sub-account ID. Required for create. The budget AMOUNT is NOT set here: it lives on the separate CampaignBudget resource (campaignBudgets:mutate), which must be created first. The Google Ads `campaign` resource has no inline daily-budget field.

start_date_time.description: Start date and time of the campaign in the customer's timezone, formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'. Use '00:00:00' for daily granularity.

bidding_strategy.description: Resource name of the portfolio bidding strategy to use. Format: customers/{customer_id}/biddingStrategies/{bidding_strategy_id}. For account-owned resources, use the same customer ID as the tool call's customer_id; in MCC workflows, this is the child/sub-account ID. Mutually exclusive with inline standard bidding strategy fields such as manual_cpc.
